name: Hof (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over black, charged at the centre with the city arms of Hof (a red castle with a lion shield on black).
history: Municipal flag of Hof; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hof arms — castle with lion shield
